title: Episode manifest
description: episode.json emitted by the upstream GPU pipeline. Unknown properties are kept and stored in episodes.metadata_jsonb -- except inside `speakers`, where the importer keeps only the fields in app/services/speaker_meta.py's allowlist and drops the rest, names and dialects included (D56).

audio_path.description: The whole episode's audio, relative to the manifest root. Optional: a pipeline that exports only clips stays valid, and the episode then has nothing for a post-export diarizer to run on (D62).

speakers.description: Per-speaker facts, keyed by the segment-level speaker_id. Fields outside `role` and `gender` are dropped at import rather than rejected (D56).
